items.title: Til lacht om jeugdig PSV: 'Beetje Donald Duck en zijn neefjes'
items.summary: Guus Til won als aanvoerder van PSV op dinsdag overtuigend van stadgenoot FC Eindhoven ( 3-0 ). De aanvallende middenvelder kende een korte voorbereiding op het nieuwe seizoen vanwege het WK met Oranje. In de Lichtstadderby droeg Til dus de aanvoerdersband, mede omdat de rest van het elftal onder leiding van Stijn Schaars bestond uit jeugdspelers.

items.title: Abusive chanting against immigrants in English football on rise, new data reveals
items.summary: Reported incidents of all discrimination reach new high Reports of abuse in grassroots football rose for fifth year Abusive chanting against immigrants has become a feature of football matches in England, according to new data from Kick It Out. Last season 39 reports of anti-immigrant chanting were made to the anti-discrimination charity, more than the previous two seasons combined. Phrases such as “stop the boats” and “send them back” were reported as being heard “at all levels of the game”, as part of a growing trend of discriminatory “mass chanting” at matches, Kick It Out said. Continue reading...

items.title: Schaars: 'Iedereen weet dat ik die ambitie heb'
items.summary: Stijn Schaars kan tevreden terugkijken op de gewonnen wedstrijd van PSV tegen FC Eindhoven ( 3-0 ). Schaars zit normaal gesproken op de bank bij Jong PSV, maar kreeg van Peter Bosz de kans bij PSV 1. Schaars is dan ook bezig om zijn trainersdiploma te halen, en steekt het niet onder stoelen of banken dat hij het ambieert om later hoofdcoach te worden in de hoofdmacht.

items.title: Retaining Rodri is key to Manchester City success under Enzo Maresca
items.summary: New manager’s No 1 priority must be to persuade World Cup-winning captain to stay as Real Madrid circle “Welcome home,” was Khaldoon al-Mubarak’s warm greeting to Enzo Maresca on his appointment last month as Manchester City manager. Now, after two previous spells at the club, the Italian’s task is to keep the chair content, and ensure a three-year contract does not end early. To achieve that, Maresca’s tenure must continue Pep Guardiola’s glittering legacy of 20 trophies across a decade of excellence. The key to the 46-year-old, who was Guardiola’s assistant during the 2022-23 treble season and City’s elite development squad leader two years before that, being successful can be summed up in two words: “Keep Rodri”. Yet with Real Madrid almost certain to launch a bid for the peerless No 6, and him seemingly wanting to play for the Spanish giants, a move away from City may become inevitable. Continue reading...

items.title: Fifa accused of ‘selling the soul of football’ over $20bn World Cup commercial rights sale plan
items.summary: World governing body set to raise millions from venture Uefa hits out at proposal and could take legal action Explainer: what Fifa’s plans mean and what happens next Fifa has announced plans to sell the commercial rights to its tournaments, including the World Cup, to private investors in a controversial move that triggered an immediate backlash from Uefa, leading European clubs and politicians. Uefa released a strongly worded statement accusing Fifa of “attempting to sell the soul of football” and is believed to be considering its legal position, while sources at numerous elite clubs were highly critical of the proposal in private. Andy Burnham, the UK’s new prime minister, condemned the move. Continue reading...

items.title: Xabi Alonso plays down Welbeck and Henderson moves after Chelsea win
items.summary: ‘There will be a lot of transfer links, a lot of rumours’ Chelsea hit back to beat Western Sydney Wanderers 6-4 Xabi Alonso refused to confirm Chelsea are interested in signing the veterans Danny Welbeck and Jordan Henderson after his first game in charge of the team, a 6-4 pre-season victory against Western Sydney Wanderers on Tuesday, but said he was looking to build a squad that had “proper balance”. Chelsea are understood to be in talks over a surprise move to sign the 35-year-old Welbeck from Brighton, with the club also reportedly interested in signing the 36-year-old Henderson from Brentford. The links to two Premier League stalwarts reflects a revised transfer strategy under Alonso, with Chelsea seeking to recruit more experienced players into their squad as opposed to focused solely on signing young players, often tying them to lengthy contracts. items.title: Milos Kerkez: ‘I’m delighted – Andoni Iraola is the perfect fit for Liverpool’
items.summary: Full-back on being reunited with former manager, the shock of Arne Slot’s sacking and being mistaken for a bridegroom It has been quite the summer for Milos Kerkez. There was time at home in Serbia, holidays in Montenegro and Spain, a frantic knock on his bedroom door one day to tell him that Arne Slot had been sacked, an unexpected reunion with Andoni Iraola shortly afterwards, and thousands of well‑wishes sent his way after being photographed escorting a bride into church in his hometown of Vrbas. Congratulations on the wedding are also extended at the start of our interview on a rooftop terrace at Liverpool’s team hotel. “No! This is wrong, everyone gets this wrong!” the full-back exclaims. “It was my oldest brother. In Serbia it is normal for the younger brothers to take the bride to the church. That’s what I did and now everyone thinks I got married. It was Rade, not me. There are three of us – Rade is the oldest, I’m the youngest and Marko is the middle one. I keep having to explain to people that I never got married. I was going around the club when we started back and people were congratulating me. I’m like: ‘No, I’m not ready for this yet!’” Continue reading...
